name: stca
description: Screen polymers with bundled STCA rules, learn readable rules from uploaded data, and use complete prompts to generate new repeat units with an LLM.

interface.longDescription: Choose bundled rules for polymer screening, learn readable rules from your own measured or computed data, or turn selected rules into complete prompts for the current or another LLM. Browse rules and copy bilingual prompts immediately. The host agent prepares the calculation backend when screening or learning is needed. Original star-containing repeat-unit SMILES are preserved, with each failed condition reported.
defaultPrompt: Show the bundled STCA rule sets so I can choose a dataset, property and target range, then screen my candidate CSV.
Learn STCA rules from my uploaded property CSV and return reusable rules with complete generation prompts.
Use my selected STCA rules to create a complete prompt for 20 new polymer repeat units, then verify the generated candidates.
